description: SplitMix64 finaliser golden vectors — the shared seed for cross-language agreement (F#/C#/TS/Rust). Sebastiano Vigna's mixer (arxiv 1410.0530 §3; public-domain reference https://prng.di.unimi.it/splitmix64.c), the deterministic mixing step behind Zeta's DST RNG. mix(x) = let z = x*GoldenRatio; z = (z ^ z>>30)*VignaA; z = (z ^ z>>27)*VignaB; z ^ z>>31 — all WRAPPING uint64 arithmetic. uint64 exceeds JSON's exact number range, so inputs and outputs are decimal STRINGS (parse to BigInt / UInt64 / u64). Cross-language agreement here is load-bearing: DST replays must produce identical pseudo-random streams across the language ports.
